entry_state: Evaluation must name its unit, information cutoff, comparator and guarantee. Reconstruction, conditional stress, causal intervention, probabilistic forecasting and set coverage are different targets. Failures and unresolved regions remain in the result population; reproducibility is separate from independent validity and human comprehension.
exit_state: A method can be locally correct yet yield a wrong composed simulation when its inputs change meaning. Carrying amount is not face value, valuation is not cash, an allowance is not borrowing eligibility, particles are not a full robust domain, and a solver tolerance is not a contractual threshold. Every interface must preserve the relevant identity, domain, timing and interpretation.

observations.finding: The proposed evaluation sequence conditions empirical claims on prior semantics/source/reconstruction work while allowing independent work to continue. It distinguishes a failed candidate from rejection of the whole uncertainty-preserving direction.
observations.disposition: retain the scope of narrow conclusions; no E3 execution or empirical result is introduced

observations.finding: The composition examples distinguish reconstructed face from carrying amount, price changes from transactions, hedge exposure from designation, and impairment from borrowing eligibility. The cache example correctly invalidates maturity-dependent policies even when displayed balances are unchanged.
observations.disposition: retain proposed discriminating cases and semantic dependencies; these are not reports that every join is implemented

observations.finding: Backtests preserve publication cutoffs, robust optimization retains the original feasible family, and reduction must preserve decision-relevant signals and thresholds. Optimizer actions must respect execution lots/timing. Cash feasibility, distribution restrictions, legal-entity recovery and default accounting remain separate.
observations.disposition: retain the complete-domain and actual-event conditions; post-hoc repair is another policy requiring its own check

observations.finding: Pricing versus physical measures, numerical versus contractual tolerances, model suggestions versus sourced evidence, and a displayed central path versus a retained family each have different semantics. The text identifies concrete misleading conclusions at these joins.
observations.disposition: retain explicit measure identity, boundary ownership and source anchors; no new defect found, continue the final UI paragraph on the next page
